senses.gloss:
Evakāraṭippaṇa,_Evakāravāda,_Evakāravādārtha,_Evakāravicāra,_Evakāravicārarahasya,_Evakārārthanirṇaya,_Evakārārthavāda,_Evakārārthavicāra
All deal with the same topic, namely the import of the particle eva, mostly from the nyāya point of view.

Evakāraṭippaṇa
by Bhavānanda Siddhāntavāgīśa. BORI. 178 of 1895-98. Mithilā. Peters. VI. p. 75 (no. 178).

Evakāradīdhitisāramañjarī
ny. by Mādhavadeva, son of Lakṣmaṇadeva, of Dhārāsūrapura on the banks of the Godāvarī, also resident for some time in Banaras. C. on the Evakāravāda portion of Raghunātha's Tattvacintāmaṇidīdhiti dealing with the import of the particle eva.
Hz. 1418. p. 133. Luck. Uni. p. 42 (Eºarthavivṛtti; a. called Mādhava Godāvari). Mithilā. PUL. II. p. 3.

A text of this name ptd. with Vādārthasaṅgraha, p.. 67-8, Bombay, 1914. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 824.
